Source: https://github.com/t4ce/Lumen.git
Pinned commit: f0a9fa408de39594b99d864deab50d027e105f07

This directory is a source-vendored snapshot of the Lumen commit previously
recorded by TRUEOS as vendor/lumen.  It is stored as ordinary files so an
offline TRUEOS checkout retains the no-std CPU implementation without needing
to initialize another submodule.

TRUEOS enables Lumen with default features disabled and `truega` enabled.
Lumen owns only the typed asynchronous backend contract; TRUEOS implements the
device operation in src/lumen/mod.rs and retains scheduling, MSI completion,
model I/O, and FPGA ABI ownership on the kernel side.
